    Package index

    Read a Data Package

    Read a datapackage.json file and its associated Data Resources from path or URL.

    read_package()
    Read a Data Package descriptor file (datapackage.json)
    read_resource()
    Read data from a Data Resource into a tibble data frame

    Create and edit a Data Package

    Create and edit a Data Package, its associated Data Resources and Table Schemas.

    create_package()
    Create a Data Package
    create_schema()
    Create a Table Schema from a data frame
    add_resource()
    Add a Data Resource
    remove_resource()
    Remove a Data Resource

    Write a Data Package

    Write a Data Package and its associated Data Resources to disk.

    write_package()
    Write a Data Package to disk

    resource_names()
    List Data Resource names
    schema()

    Check a Data Package object

    Get the specification version number
